units.upstream: worker.terminate() with a live Bun.$ subprocess does not leak its pipe readers
units.note: Upstream starts this command inside a Worker, waits for the child's flag file, then terminates the worker and checks (ASAN/LSan) for leaks with the child still running `sleep 100`. Worker termination and leak detection are Bun-internal; the case runs the same command to completion with the sleep shortened to 0.1s.

The 1 MiB stdin buffer is larger than the pipe capacity and never read by the child; the command must still finish.
